fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-01-25 around 16:55 hrs, it was reported that a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 12,00,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. Bhuvana Bai approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000344. A person named Hariharan Subramani, associated with the number 9000000044, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100070 as the destination of the transfer. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference, physical documents and transaction records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Bank transaction reference; Physical document; Transaction record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported unauthorised debits after sharing details during a call.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, mobile number, documents, suspect, receiving account, main street, afternoon
